answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The delta is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pulse. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
